units.source_text: “你说的固然不错，但此事暂勿泄露！

en.t: What you say is certainly right, but do not let this matter leak out for now!
Nor do you need to inform His Majesty.

units.source_text: 大约这妮子前回犯了过失，皇上并不嫌弃，依旧宠爱她，

en.t: Most likely, when this girl made a mistake before, His Majesty did not reject her and still continued to favor her,

units.source_text: 因而有恃无恐，便做出这种事情来。

en.t: so she grew fearless because she had someone to rely on, and went on to do such a thing.

units.source_text: 你先悄悄地训诫她一番，

en.t: First, quietly give her a warning,

units.source_text: 如果她不听，这个罪过由我一人承当。”

en.t: and if she will not listen, I alone will bear the blame for this offense.”

units.source_text: 弘徽殿太后听了这话，怒气还是不消。

en.t: When the Empress Dowager of Kokiden heard these words, her anger still did not subside.

units.source_text: 她想：“六妹和我住在一起，人目众多，也算得无隙可乘了。

en.t: She thought, “My sixth younger sister lives together with me, and with so many eyes watching, there should have been no opening to exploit.

units.source_text: 然而这源氏毫无忌惮，竟敢钻门入户，

en.t: Yet this Genji had no restraint at all, and actually dared to slip through the gates and enter the residence,

units.source_text: 简直是蔑视我们，侮弄我们！”

en.t: which is nothing less than looking down on us and making fools of us!”
The more she thought about it, the angrier she became.

units.source_text: 忽念趁此把那源氏惩办一下，倒是个好机会。

en.t: Suddenly she thought that this would be a good chance to punish that Genji.
So she carefully considered all sorts of means.
